status.evidence: According to Companies House and official company announcements, Cubo Solutions Limited remains active and was acquired by Fuel Card Services (part of DCC plc) in July 2024, later rebranding its trading identity to Motia in 2025.

Cubo Solutions Limited.label: Cubo Solutions Limited (acquired by DCC Management Services Limited)

claims.claim: Cubo Solutions Limited supplied its telematics tracking and communication services to an 80-strong HGV fleet managed by Kennedy International Transport during the 2023 tour across the United Kingdom and Ireland.
claims.source: Fleet.ie Press Release Dec 2023 / Cubo official statement

claims.claim: The company reports that its telematics tracking hardware captures vehicle speed, heading, 3D acceleration/braking data, and unit orientation, alongside supporting external wired sensor inputs for tracking temperature, vehicle door state, and attached equipment states like pumps or tail-lifts, as detailed in its standard GPS tracking documentation.
claims.source: Cubo Solutions GPS Tracking terms and conditions documentation (://wearecubo.com)

claims.claim: The company's mobile deployment, CUBO GPS, provides an integrated vehicle tracking system verified to be compatible with over 200 distinct GPS tracking models to deliver real-time location and fuel usage insights.
claims.source: CUBO GPS Mobile Application documentation on Google Play Store

claims.claim: The company is registered with the UK Office of Communications (Ofcom) as an approved RID holder, establishing its verified presence within the UK telecommunications regulatory framework.
claims.source: UK Ofcom Reseller Identification (RID) Registry (Reference RID KEA)

claims.claim: The company, trading as Motia following its merger with Fuel Card Services, features direct API integration into customer Transport Management Systems (TMS) and third-party software including Qargo, Aquarius IT, Transporeon, and Project44.
claims.note: While API integration with Transport Management Systems (TMS), Aquarius IT, and Qargo is documented, direct integration specifically with Transporeon and Project44 could not be verified in published sources.
claims.source: Motia official website case studies and corporate acquisition announcements

claims.claim: In a fleet deployment case study for BM Transport, the company implemented a fully integrated platform connecting 4-way DVR cameras, live tracking, and automatic tachograph data downloads via API into the client's existing haulage operations managing a fleet size of 160 vehicles.

Cubo Solutions Limited deployed an integrated telematics and vehicle camera system for Essex Bulk Services (EBS) to support its 125-strong commercial fleet, as reported by Transport Operator (https://transportoperator.co.uk/2023/05/22/ebs-stays-safe-with-cubo/).

Cubo Solutions Limited secured a telematics contract with logistics operator FreshLinc and a £500,000 commercial fleet monitoring contract with DCC Retail & Oil, as reported by Cubo Solutions (https://wearecubo.com/celebrating-20-years/).
The acquisition of Cubo Solutions Limited by Leeds-based Fuel Card Services (part of DCC plc) from private equity firm Cordovan Capital Management was announced in July 2024.
The company reported a 23 per cent increase in connected devices over a two-year period during its brand repositioning announcement.

Motia (the unified brand of Fuel Card Services and Cubo Solutions Limited following its 2024 acquisition) established a strategic distribution partnership with the Federation of Small Businesses (FSB) in June 2026 to provide its advanced telematics and fuel card solutions to FSB's 200,000 members across the UK.

The company delivers its specialized commercial fleet tracking and optimization technology via "The Greener HGV Programme" in an institutional distribution partnership with the Irish Government and The South East Energy Agency.

The company reports that following expansion in the Republic of Ireland and Great Britain markets, 70 per cent of its customer base is located outside of Northern Ireland, driven by contracts such as one with UK logistics provider FreshLinc.
Following its July 2024 acquisition by Fuel Card Services, the group rebranded to Motia in 2025, managing over 50,000 active customer accounts across the UK and Ireland.
Cubo Solutions Limited operates its localized telematics office out of Unit E1, Plasketts Close, Kilbegs Business Park, Antrim, Northern Ireland.
